description: This is a Java unit test file for the 'PolicyModified' class within the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains tests verifying immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception handling for the 'PolicyModified' class.

classes.name: PolicyModifiedTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the 'PolicyModified' class, covering immutability, equality, JSON conversion, and exception handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the 'PolicyModified' class is immutable and that 'Policy' is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of 'hashCode' and 'equals' methods of 'PolicyModified'.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicy
methods.description: Tests that creating a 'PolicyModified' instance with a null policy throws 'NullPointerException'.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyId
methods.description: Tests that creating a 'PolicyModified' instance with a policy having null ID throws 'PolicyIdInvalidException'.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that 'toJson' method produces the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests that a 'PolicyModified' instance can be created correctly from valid JSON.
